title: Fuel Pressure Out of Range
shortDescription: Fuel rail pressure outside expected range.
fullDescription: Polaris ATV/UTV/snow ECU reports fuel rail pressure out of spec. Often a failing pump or leaking regulator.

faq.a: Yes, E10 fuel breaks down rubber pump components.

title: Manifold Air Pressure Sensor
shortDescription: MAP sensor signal out of range.
fullDescription: Polaris ECU detects MAP sensor fault. Performance reduced.

fixSteps.title: Replace MAP
fixSteps.instruction: Install new MAP sensor on intake.

title: Engine Coolant Temp
fullDescription: Polaris ECU detects coolant temp sensor fault. Fan logic and fuel mixture impacted.

fixSteps.title: Replace ECT
fixSteps.instruction: Install new sensor and refill coolant.

faq.a: Yes especially after years of vibration.

title: Engine Speed Sensor
fullDescription: Polaris CKP/engine speed signal lost. Engine no-start or stall.

faq.a: EFI bikes won't push start; tow to repair.

title: EBS / Engine Brake Fault
shortDescription: Engine braking system fault on Polaris ATV.
fullDescription: Polaris ATVs with EBS report this when system cannot apply engine braking. Limp home active.

fixSteps.title: Diagnose with Digital Wrench
fixSteps.instruction: Connect Polaris Digital Wrench to read live data.

faq.a: Yes but use brakes earlier; engine braking off.

title: ECU Internal Fault
fullDescription: Polaris ECU internal diagnostic failure. Often resolved by software update.

fixSteps.title: ECU update
fixSteps.instruction: Apply latest Polaris ECU firmware via Digital Wrench.

fixSteps.title: Replace ECU
fixSteps.instruction: Install replacement ECU if internal fault.

faq.a: Often yes, especially on early Slingshot models.

title: Controller Memory Fault
fullDescription: Polaris ECU memory or programming fault. Often after battery disconnect with low voltage.

fixSteps.title: Charge battery
fixSteps.instruction: Fully charge battery and clear codes.

faq.a: Yes, battery tender prevents these glitches.

title: Throttle Body / ETC Fault
fullDescription: Polaris ETC fault on drive-by-wire vehicles. Throttle response may be limited.

fixSteps.title: Clean throttle body
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and clean ETC throttle plate.

title: Camshaft Position Sensor
fullDescription: Polaris cam sensor circuit fault. Engine may run in batch mode.

fixSteps.title: Replace CMP
fixSteps.instruction: Install new sensor on cylinder head.

title: DEF Tank Level Low
shortDescription: Diesel exhaust fluid level low on diesel models.
fullDescription: Polaris diesel UTV with DEF system reports low DEF tank. Engine power will derate if not refilled.

fixSteps.title: Refill DEF
fixSteps.instruction: Top off DEF tank with quality fluid.

fixSteps.title: Replace level sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If gauge wrong, replace level sensor.

faq.a: No; emissions strategy will derate engine.
